title: Extension by zero for open immersions
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring; for $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$ everything below is about abelian sheaves. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $U_{\Et}$, $X_{\Et}$ be the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. A *sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules* on $T_{\Et}$ ($T=U,X$) is a presheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ whose underlying presheaf of abelian groups is a sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]; with $\Lambda$-linear natural transformations they form the category $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$, and $\Mod(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z)=\Ab(T_{\Et})$.

*Objects over $U$.* Let $V\to X$ be an object of $X_{\Et}$. Since $j$ is an open immersion it is a monomorphism of schemes, so there is at most one $X$-morphism $\varphi:V\to U$; it exists exactly when the image of $V$ in $X$ lies in $j(U)$, and then we say that $V$ *factors through $U$*. In that case $(\mathrm{id}_V,\varphi):V\to V\times_XU$ is an isomorphism, so $\varphi$ is the base change of the etale $V\to X$ along $j$, hence etale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits], and $(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}U)$ is an object of $U_{\Et}$. If $a:V'\to V$ is a morphism of $X_{\Et}$ and $V$ factors through $U$ by $\varphi$, then $V'$ factors through $U$ by $\varphi a$ and $a$ is a morphism $(V',\varphi a)\to(V,\varphi)$ of $U_{\Et}$.

*The presheaf.* For $F\in\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)$ let $j_{p!}F$ be the presheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$
$$
(j_{p!}F)(V)=\begin{cases}F(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}U),&V\text{ factors through }U\text{ by }\varphi,\\0,&\text{otherwise},\end{cases}
$$
whose restriction along $a:V'\to V$ is the restriction of $F$ along $a:(V',\varphi a)\to(V,\varphi)$ when $V$ factors through $U$, and the zero map otherwise. A morphism $\alpha:F\to F'$ induces $j_{p!}\alpha$, equal to $\alpha_{(V,\varphi)}$ when $V$ factors through $U$ and $0$ otherwise; this makes $j_{p!}$ a functor to presheaves of $\Lambda$-modules. This is the presheaf $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{s\in\Hom_X(V,U)}F(V,s)$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] for the etale morphism $v=j$, whose index set $\Hom_X(V,U)$ has at most one element.

*Extension by zero.* $j_!F$ is the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $j_{p!}F$ as a presheaf of $\Lambda$-modules, and $j_!\alpha$ is the sheafification of $j_{p!}\alpha$. This defines the functor
$$
j_!:\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)\longrightarrow\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda),
$$
called *extension by zero*; for $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$ it is $j_!:\Ab(U_{\Et})\to\Ab(X_{\Et})$. It is applied to complexes degreewise.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, extension by zero is the exact
functor

$$
 j_!:\Ab(U_{\Et})\longrightarrow\Ab(X_{\Et})
$$

left adjoint to $j^{-1}$. It is characterized on geometric stalks by

$$
 (j_!F)_{\bar x}=
 \begin{cases}
 F_{\bar x},&\bar x\text{ lies in }U,\\
 0,&\bar x\text{ lies in }X\setminus U.
 \end{cases}
$$

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks etale-cohomology Section 03S2 (Definition 03S3, the presheaf j_{p!} and 'j_! is the sheafification of j_{p!}', Exercise 03S4, Proposition 03S5) and Modules on Sites Lemmas 03DI, 03DJ. The old statement cited itself ('the functor of [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]') and defined j_! only by its properties (exact left adjoint of j^{-1}, stalk formula); it is now the construction: for an open immersion j the presheaf V ↦ F(V→U) if V→X factors through U (uniquely, j being a monomorphism; the factorization is etale as a base change, lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits), 0 otherwise, sheafified (def-weil-pbc-sheafification), with restriction maps and action on morphisms written out, for sheaves of Λ-modules with any commutative Λ (Λ = Z: abelian sheaves; the blueprint's 'finite Λ' is a special case). It is noted to be the case v = j of def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension (direct sum over Hom_X(V,U), at most one summand). The claims move to statement nodes, which this definition does not cite (they depend on it): lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction (j_! ⊣ j^{-1}, Stacks 03S3/03S4/03DI, new), lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact (Stacks 03DJ/03S5, new), lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-stalks (stalk formula, Stacks 03S5/0710/04HU, new; the blueprint's F_{x̄} is made precise as F_{ū} for the unique lift ū), and the short exact sequence 0 → j_!j^{-1}F → F → i_*i^{-1}F → 0 (Stacks 095L), which already has the node lem-weil-pbc-open-closed-short-exact (created by the worker of lem-weil-pbc-curve-dense-open-localization). The grab-bags are replaced: def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves → def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves (Λ-module sheaves defined inline as presheaves of Λ-modules whose underlying abelian presheaf is a sheaf); def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions → def-pc-scheme and def-weil-open-immersion. def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks (now used by the stalk node) and def-cbc-open-immersion-square (unused) are dropped.
